From 9037caa09ed345b35325200f0e4acf5a94ae0a65 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Steven Rostedt (Google)" <rostedt@goodmis.org>
Date: Mon, 30 Oct 2023 12:15:23 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] eventfs: Fix kerneldoc of eventfs_remove_rec()

The eventfs_remove_rec() had some missing parameters in the kerneldoc
comment above it. Also, rephrase the description a bit more to have a bit
more correct grammar.

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-trace-kernel/20231030121523.0b2225a7@gandalf.local.home

Cc: Masami Hiramatsu <mhiramat@kernel.org>
Cc: Mark Rutland <mark.rutland@arm.com>
Fixes: 5790b1fb3d672 ("eventfs: Remove eventfs_file and just use eventfs_inode");
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/oe-kbuild-all/202310052216.4SgqasWo-lkp@intel.com/
Signed-off-by: Steven Rostedt (Google) <rostedt@goodmis.org>

diff --git a/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c b/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c
index 5536860eb2ff..9f612a8f009d 100644
--- a/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c
+++ b/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c
@@ -796,9 +796,11 @@ static void free_ei(struct rcu_head *head)
 /**
  * eventfs_remove_rec - remove eventfs dir or file from list
  * @ei: eventfs_inode to be removed.
+ * @head: the list head to place the deleted @ei and children
+ * @level: prevent recursion from going more than 3 levels deep.
  *
- * This function recursively remove eventfs_inode which
- * contains info of file or dir.
+ * This function recursively removes eventfs_inodes which
+ * contains info of files and/or directories.
  */
 static void eventfs_remove_rec(struct eventfs_inode *ei, struct list_head *head, int level)
 {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `fs/tracefs/event_inode.c`**
   - The kerneldoc comment for the function `eventfs_remove_rec()` was updated to include two missing parameters: `@head` and `@level`.
   - The description of the function was rephrased for improved grammar and clarity. Specifically, it now states that the function "recursively removes eventfs_inodes which contains info of files and/or directories" instead of the previous wording.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `fs/tracefs/event_inode.c` file enhance the documentation of the `eventfs_remove_rec()` function. By adding the missing parameters and improving the grammatical structure of the description, the patch aims to provide clearer guidance for developers regarding the function's purpose and usage. This change is particularly important for maintaining code readability and understanding, especially in collaborative environments where multiple developers may interact with the codebase.
